Distributed Data Systems

Reliable decisions require more than available services.

A distributed platform can be fully available while separate components produce incompatible answers.

Chalapathi KoneniSenior Data Engineering LeaderEngineering work →Research →

Patterns I focus on

  • Cross-system reconciliation and evidence comparison.
  • Temporal alignment across asynchronous pipelines.
  • Failure containment and restartable processing.
  • Observability that preserves enough context to diagnose silent failures.
  • Controls that prevent technically valid but incorrect outputs from becoming decisions.
